dialogues.speaker: Veselov
dialogues.text: Hey, buddy, hear me out. I noticed something strange. We've got a machine here in town for mining ice, right? So why make a whole crowd of workers chip away at it by hand?

dialogues.speaker: Veselov
dialogues.text: And I heard that the machine breaks down all the time, too. Buddy, you don't think someone's up to something shady here in Svetloledovka, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Demidov
dialogues.text: Hello, friend. I hope you don't mind me asking, seeing as we've only just met... Where are you from? You look dressed for ice-mining work, but somehow, you seem... unfamiliar.

dialogues.speaker: Veselov
dialogues.text: Me? I'm from... Morepesok. Only started work here a couple days ago, so that's probably why you haven't seen me around. Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Demidov
dialogues.text: Oh, from Morepesok, are you? Then you and that new safety officer, Pashkov, you two are from the same place. You must know him pretty well, then?

dialogues.speaker: Veselov
dialogues.text: Pashkov? Ah! Right, right, of course! I know him very well! We drink together at the tavern all the time!

dialogues.speaker: Demidov
dialogues.text: So what about it? Are you saying this has something to do with Pashkov? But I heard Sobolev was the one in charge of that machine.

dialogues.speaker: Veselov
dialogues.text: Hah. Whether it does or not, you know perfectly well yourself. If you want information, then ask me straight! I've got nothing to say to a sneaky fool like you!

dialogues.speaker: Veselov
dialogues.text: Now get lost. You're blocking my sun!
